title: Associativity forced by the natural formal-kernel lift formula
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $\mathcal I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf and $F$ a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], with pieces $B_m$, $K_n$, projections $\pi_m$ and inclusions $\iota_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces]. Let $A$ be a graded sheaf algebra on $B$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], and let $\mu_{m,n,U}:B_m(U)\times K_n(U)\to K_{m+n}(U)$ be any bilinear family compatible with restriction. Suppose that for every $a\in\mathcal I^m(U)$, $x\in K_n(U)$ and lift $t\in\mathcal F_{m+n+1}(U)$ of $\iota_n(x)$, $\iota_{m+n}(\mu(\pi_m(a),x))=a t$. Suppose also that for every $a\in\mathcal I^l(U)$ and $b\in\mathcal I^m(U)$ there is $c\in\mathcal I^{l+m}(U)$ whose image in $\mathcal O_X(U)$ is $ab$ and whose class is $A.mul(\pi_l(a),\pi_m(b))$. Then for all $l,m,n,U$, $a\in B_l(U)$, $b\in B_m(U)$ and $x\in K_n(U)$, $\mu_{l+m,n}(A.mul(a,b),x)=\mu_{l,m+n}(a,\mu_{m,n}(b,x))$, with the codomains identified along $(l+m)+n=l+(m+n)$. This asserts only associativity of an already given family, with no existence or unit conclusion.

source.place: Lemma 087Z (lemma-finite-over-rees-algebra), its associated graded construction, and Section 0EHN; expanded local-lift argument. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087Z and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EHN.

proof.text: The adjacent transition is a quotient projection followed by the quotient isomorphism from F.property. Induct along n <= r to prove every transition epic. The coefficient projections are cokernel projections and hence epic. Forgetting to abelian sheaves preserves epimorphisms; Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi gives local lifts. Iterate it three times and restrict the earlier lifts to get coefficient representatives and a lift t of the inclusion of x on one common neighbourhood.

At this neighbourhood reduce t from F_(l+m+n+1) to F_(m+n+1). Functoriality of F shows its further reduction is the inclusion of x. The action formula identifies the inclusion of mu(b,x) with b times that middle-level section. Since transitions are linear, b t is a highest-level lift of the inclusion of mu(b,x). A second application of the formula identifies the right-associated inclusion with a(b t). The representative multiplication hypothesis supplies c with image ab and class A.mul(a,b); apply the formula to c,x,t for the left-associated inclusion, transporting t across Nat.add_assoc. Both sides are equal by mul_smul.

Kernel inclusions are sectionwise injective by Mathlib Scheme.Modules.injective_map_kernelι, and the degree-zero inclusion is the identity. Cancel them and transport along Nat.add_assoc to get local HEq. Naturality of the action and A.mul identifies these with the restricted original outputs. Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' glues local equality; the proof generalizes the two indices and eliminates their equality before applying sheaf separation. This includes empty opens, zero modules and zero degrees.

lean.statement:
theorem formalKernel_bilinear_action_associative {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (A : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I))
    (act : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens),
      (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.obj (op U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
        (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)]
          (formalKernelPiece F (m + n)).val.obj (op U))
    (hnat : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U)
        (a : (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.obj (op U))
        (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U)),
      (formalKernelPiece F (m + n)).val.map (homOfLE h).op (act m n U a x) =
        act m n V ((formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.map (homOfLE h).op a)
          ((formalKernelPiece F n).val.map (homOfLE h).op x))
    (hact : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
          (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
          (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U))
          (t : (F.obj.obj (op (m + n))).val.obj (op U)),
          (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_left n m)).op).val.app (op U) t =
            (formalKernelι F n).val.app (op U) x →
          (formalKernelι F (m + n)).val.app (op U)
            (act m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a) x) =
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) • t)
    (hmul : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
        (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
        (b : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1.val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ c : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).1.val.obj (op U),
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).2.val.app (op U) c =
            (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) *
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2.val.app (op U) b)) ∧
          A.mul m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a)
            ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I n).val.app (op U) b) =
              (formalAssociatedGradedπ I (m + n)).val.app (op U) c) :
    ∀ (l m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
      (a : (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I l).val.obj (op U))
      (b : (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I m).val.obj (op U))
      (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U)),
      HEq (act (l + m) n U (A.mul l m U a b) x)
        (act l (m + n) U a (act m n U b x))
